items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yeah, Marshall. He lived over there on 29th Street... I'd been playing quite a bit.

ctx.x: Let's see, who else in this period? We did touch on Marshall Royal. Did you know him when he was a young man?

Oh, yeah, Marshall. He lived over there on 29th Street, 28th Street or 29th. 28th. And that's where he had -- he'd come out of the bushes and bring his horns with him. I say the bushes, that's -- I'd been playing quite a bit.
